title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: concrete cutting
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Concrete saw cutting and core drilling
swms.task: Saw cut and core drill openings in the post-tensioned slabs and walls with wall saws and core drills.

facts.silicaControls: Concrete is cut wet or with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.fallControl: Each opening is barricaded before cutting and covered with a fixed, marked cover as soon as the section is removed.

rules.phrase: Cutting concrete is processing a crystalline silica substance
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 529A, s 529B, s 529C
